name: Gwalchmei
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwalchmei, also called the son of Gwyar, was a Welsh hero. Arthurian legend names him the swiftest runner on earth. The tales also hold him among the men who advised King Arthur. His speed gave him a ready voice in the court. His counsel won him a place in the story of the realm.

okr.objective: Present the swift Welsh hero Gwalchmei and his role.
key_results: Use the name of the son of Gwyar.
Call him the swiftest runner on earth.
Keep him among the advisers of Arthur.
Hold his place in the legends of the realm.
